metadata.description: Schema navigation session exploring Supplier-Part-PartSupp-Lineitem join chain for supply chain analysis

turns.content: I want to analyze our supply chain. What tables are available that relate to suppliers and parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify SUPPLIER, PART, PARTSUPP, LINEITEM tables

turns.content: What columns does the SUPPLIER table have?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list SUPPLIER columns: S_SUPPKEY, S_NAME, S_ADDRESS, S_NATIONKEY, S_PHONE, S_ACCTBAL, S_COMMENT

turns.content: What about the PART table? What columns does it have?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list PART columns: P_PARTKEY, P_NAME, P_MFGR, P_BRAND, P_TYPE, P_SIZE, P_CONTAINER, P_RETAILPRICE, P_COMMENT

turns.content: What is the PARTSUPP table for?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should explain PARTSUPP as the junction table between PART and SUPPLIER

turns.content: What columns does PARTSUPP have?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list PARTSUPP columns: PS_PARTKEY, PS_SUPPKEY, PS_AVAILQTY, PS_SUPPLYCOST, PS_COMMENT

turns.content: What about LINEITEM? What columns does it have?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list LINEITEM columns including L_ORDERKEY, L_PARTKEY, L_SUPPKEY, L_LINENUMBER, L_QUANTITY, L_EXTENDEDPRICE, L_DISCOUNT, L_TAX, etc.

turns.content: How do I join PART to SUPPLIER? What are the key relationships?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should explain PARTSUPP as junction: PART.P_PARTKEY = PARTSUPP.PS_PARTKEY, SUPPLIER.S_SUPPKEY = PARTSUPP.PS_SUPPKEY

turns.content: How does LINEITEM connect to these tables?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should explain LINEITEM joins: L_PARTKEY = PART.P_PARTKEY, L_SUPPKEY = SUPPLIER.S_SUPPKEY

turns.content: Give me a simple count of parts supplied by each supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join PARTSUPP to SUPPLIER and count by supplier

turns.content: Add the supplier name to the results.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should include S_NAME in the output

turns.content: Now also show the total available quantity across all parts for each supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add SUM(PS_AVAILQTY) to the query

turns.content: The LINEITEM table has both L_PARTKEY and L_SUPPKEY. When joining LINEITEM to PART and SUPPLIER, always use L_PARTKEY for PART and L_SUPPKEY for SUPPLIER.

annotations.establishesFilter: Use L_PARTKEY for PART joins, L_SUPPKEY for SUPPLIER joins
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge the join key preference

turns.content: What columns did you say the PART table has? I want to double-check the part type column.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall P_TYPE column from earlier schema exploration

turns.content: Show me the total lineitem revenue by supplier for orders in 1995.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join LINEITEM to SUPPLIER and aggregate revenue

turns.content: Now add the part manufacturer (P_MFGR) to group by manufacturer and supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to PART and include P_MFGR in GROUP BY

turns.content: What were the columns in PARTSUPP again?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall PARTSUPP columns from earlier

turns.content: Add the supply cost (PS_SUPPLYCOST) information to our revenue analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to PARTSUPP to include PS_SUPPLYCOST

turns.content: Show me the profit margin: revenue minus supply cost by supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate L_EXTENDEDPRICE - PS_SUPPLYCOST * L_QUANTITY

turns.content: What possible values does L_LINESTATUS have?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should query LINEITEM schema for L_LINESTATUS values

turns.content: Filter to only include line items with status 'O' (outstanding).

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add status filter to query

turns.content: Show me the top 10 suppliers by profit margin for parts manufactured by 'Manufacturer#1'.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to specific manufacturer and rank by profit

turns.content: Add the part brand to this result.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should include P_BRAND in output

turns.content: Earlier you mentioned PS_AVAILQTY. What was the available quantity for each supplier again?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall the available quantity calculation

turns.content: Show me a comparison of available quantity vs sold quantity by supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare PS_AVAILQTY with sum of L_QUANTITY

turns.content: Now do the same analysis but for 'Manufacturer#1' brand 'Brand#23' parts only.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply the same comparison with brand filter

turns.content: What about the SUPPLIER table - does it have a region or nation reference?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should mention S_NATIONKEY column

turns.content: Show me the full supply chain query: join SUPPLIER, PART, PARTSUPP, and LINEITEM, showing revenue, cost, and profit by supplier and part type, only outstanding line items.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should produce 4-table join with all established filters

turns.content: Add the nation name for each supplier by joining through S_NATIONKEY.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to NATION table via S_NATIONKEY

turns.content: Just to confirm - what are the join keys we're using between LINEITEM, PART, and SUPPLIER?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: L_PARTKEY=P_PARTKEY, L_SUPPKEY=S_SUPPKEY

turns.content: Now show me revenue by part container type.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should group by P_CONTAINER

turns.content: Add supplier nation to that breakdown.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to NATION and include in GROUP BY

turns.content: Final query: join SUPPLIER, PART, PARTSUPP, and LINEITEM, show revenue and profit by supplier nation and part type, filter to outstanding items, using L_PARTKEY for PART joins and L_SUPPKEY for SUPPLIER joins.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should produce complete final query with all established join keys and filters

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Use L_PARTKEY for PART joins, L_SUPPKEY for SUPPLIER joins
persistedCorrections.description: Always use L_PARTKEY when joining LINEITEM to PART, and L_SUPPKEY when joining to SUPPLIER

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Filter to only outstanding line items with status 'O'
persistedCorrections.description: All queries should include L_LINESTATUS = 'O' filter
